facts.hub.1: Dinosaurs lived in three periods: Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous.
facts.hub.2: The word 'dinosaur' means 'terrible lizard' — but birds are dinosaurs' closest living relatives!
facts.hub.3: A Tyrannosaurus rex's arms were tiny, but stronger than a grown-up human's!
facts.hub.4: Star Fossils aren't real — but real fossils can be over 3 billion years old.
facts.w1.1: Fossils form when minerals slowly replace buried bones — it takes at least 10,000 years!
facts.w1.2: Igneous rock comes from cooled lava or magma. 'Igneous' means 'fiery'!
facts.w1.3: Sedimentary rock forms in layers, like a sandwich pressed for millions of years.
facts.w1.4: Metamorphic rock is rock that CHANGED — squeezed and heated deep underground.
facts.w1.5: Your skeleton does three jobs: support, protection, and movement.
facts.w2.1: A small gear driving a big gear turns fast but gently; a big gear driving a small one turns slowly but strongly.
facts.w2.2: A 4-tooth gear driving a 12-tooth gear spins 3 whole times for each turn — that's a 1:3 ratio!
facts.w2.3: Levers, pulleys, gears and cams are 'simple machines' — they trade speed for strength.
facts.w2.4: A shape is symmetrical if one half mirrors the other along a line of symmetry.
facts.w2.5: The ×4 table is just the ×2 table doubled. Double, then double again!
